text:
Extend the attached persistent Launch decision node for a synthetic release-readiness walkthrough. Use the normal graph client and finish with graph.submit(interactionNode), the documented terminal authoring submission. Do not call recursiveComplete, delegate, execute invoke controls, browse, or call any external service.
Create an independent response root with three connected nodes titled "Prepare", "Measure", and "Decide". Include a short expansion checklist layer with two connected nodes titled "Check error rate" and "Confirm rollback". Make a normal Expand from Measure to that checklist.
Add TWO node-owned navigate actions to the exact attached Launch decision node id 22: a Reference labeled "Release readiness" targeting THIS interaction's new response ROOT, and an Expand labeled "Readiness checklist" targeting the new checklist layer. The attached node must not be inserted into the new response or checklist. Omit sourceLayerId on these new node-owned actions. Both new actions and their targets must be accepted atomically with this interaction.
Explicitly replace the attached node's full compiled HTML Node Detail using getNodePresentation and replaceNodePresentation with its current optimistic revision. Preserve its persistent identity, title, and semantic detail EXACTLY; do not submit/update the existing node. Preserve and expose the original "Draft rollout recommendation" invoke action with the exact original binding, and expose both new navigate controls. Read the actual accepted action identities/provenance before compiling. The persistent node's clientKey is launch-decision; it appears in source root layer 7 and attached child layer 6. An existing action's sourceLayer binding is its original canonical provenance, not the attached occurrence. Build the compiler's binding objects from these stable identities without submitting synthetic existing builders/layers. For newly added navigation, a binding without sourceLayer is supported. Use supported graph-client declarations to confirm exact APIs.
Use a coherent compact layout: decision summary, readiness status text, then all three clearly labeled controls. Do not discard old controls or synthesize inert HTML buttons. This request explicitly includes the full presentation replacement, so do not use the unresolved rich-detail/no-replacement path.
